<header class="page-header"><div class="page-shell">
<p class="eyebrow">Research</p>
<h1>Research</h1>
<p class="section-lead">I study how people value healthcare, how they process information when making decisions, and how they respond to policy. My work combines health and behavioural economics with discrete choice experiments, eye tracking, applied econometrics, and decision-support tools.</p>
</div></header>

<section class="content-section"><div class="page-shell narrow">
<h2>Research areas</h2>
<div class="theme-list">
<article class="theme"><h3><a href="/research/projects/health-preferences-dce/">Health preferences &amp; behavioural economics <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></h3><p>Measuring what people value in health and healthcare, and how observed decisions depart from standard models.</p></article>
<article class="theme"><h3><a href="/research/projects/eye-tracking-attribute-ordering/">Choice, attention &amp; information processing <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></h3><p>Using process evidence to understand how people read, weight, and act on information in multi-attribute choices.</p></article>
<article class="theme"><h3><a href="/research/projects/decision-support-tools/">Health policy &amp; decision tools <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></h3><p>Translating preference and economic evidence into policy analysis, implementation choices, and practical decision support.</p></article>
</div>

<h2>Selected projects</h2>
<div class="theme-list">
<article class="theme"><h3><a href="/research/projects/mandeval/">MandEval <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></h3><p>Effectiveness and consequences of vaccine mandates, together with public preferences for alternative mandate designs.</p></article>
<article class="theme"><h3><a href="/research/projects/fetp-india/">FETP India <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></h3><p>Economic and preference evidence for scaling field-epidemiology training, developed with the World Bank.</p></article>
<article class="theme"><h3><a href="/research/projects/eye-tracking-attribute-ordering/">Eye tracking &amp; attribute ordering <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></h3><p>How attribute position changes attention, information processing, and estimated preferences in discrete choice experiments.</p></article>
</div>
